body.p: There have been witchers as long as this earth has existed. Formerly, people were afraid of these witchers. Of course, they were afraid of them. At that time, people stayed alone in camps. One stays alone here, other one stays alone there, being afraid of these witchers. Where they hear a witcher's sounds, they would move to another land, to a distant place. One man stayed alone in a camp. He would not stay home during the day. He went hunting. He had children. When he was absent, a witcher came. The witcher was probably the hairy body, that's what people told about him. People called him the hairy body, the hairy man. And then he took away the woman.[ShA:] It means, the wife of the man who was not at home. Her children stayed here crying. He took away their mother. So the woman started screaming, crying. He immediately took her into the forest. There he had a tent made of spruce branches. He placed her there, into this tent. The woman is afraid, of course she is afraid. The hairy one is a hairy giant. But ad for him, say, he treats her very well. He took her as his wife, after all, he stole her. He treats her very well, but this woman is very afraid. Say, she thinks, "This one will probably eat me!". Not at all. He took her as his wife. Some years have passed, probably, one year has passed, probably. At some point she stopped being afraid. He treats her well, why she will be afraid of him? After all, this woman is a human. She cannot stay without work. This guy understands human speech. Probably, he understands it. Of course, he understands it. Well, say the woman, "What if you find people? While you go around, you will see people. Ask a kamus and a vein from the people. The witcher thought, "What is this finally? What is a vein? How does the witcher know what a vein is? What a kamus is, what a skin is, how can the witcher know? Say, the witcher thought: "How then, what is this, what is kamus, what is skin, what is vein? "Ask for veins," she said. Well, anyway, the witcher went around again. How could the poor woman know where he would go in the forest. She is there in the witcher's tent. Her tears, probably, dried up. And her husband ... Seeing the witcher's footprints, she got afraid. How could he go right there. She said: "What if he comes there again, maybe he'll suddenly take my children away.". Maybe the next day or after several days had passed, she thought: "Where should he go, this witcher?", that's what she probably thought. Oh, he went to some place. When now ... Still he is absent and absent. And one day these people, many people were staying there, the tents were visible. And as for him, he started a song. As for there, there are many people, there are many tents. He started a song, he is walking. My wife said, "Ask a kamus!" My wife said, "Ask a skin!" My wife said, "Ask a vein!" This means. Say, he thinks, "What is this still, a vein?". Then he said. A kamus - what it would be? A skin - what it would be? Then he sings again so. A vein - what it would be? The forest is already shaking, there are a lot of people. Many people stayed together in a camp. This song can be heard from far away. Then he stopped having approached the tents. And he stopped nearby. Somehow he probably speaks the witchers' language. These people stood up in one place. They are holding arrows. But how can they kill a giant with an arrow? And he still stands in front of people. Then they heard his screams, his terrible song. "A skin is necessary, a kamus is necessary," this voice can be heard from far away. So, now the man whose wife was taken away earlier said, "My wife was taken away by such a being", that's what he said. This is now how my wife had said. "Ask for a kamus, ask for a skin," that's what she said. What is this, what are skins, what are kamuses. But then the people understood him some way. Now from the terrible land his cry is heard, his terrible song. "This seems to be the giant, they say, who took away a man's wife. So these women. One woman threw a kamus in front of him, another threw a skin in front of him. One of them threw a vein. And he understood that many things did not seem to be given, he took everything with a single palm. He turned to the sun. Nothing ... This happened in a way. Somehow, he probably thinks to himself. He grabbed all the skins that they threw, say. People probably look after him: it seems like he only took one or two steps. And now only his trace was visible, he left. He reached home. Again he sings walking. He started singing again as he entered the forest. He says again. My wife said, "Bring a kamus!" Bring a kamus! My wife said, "Bring a skin!" My wife said, "Bring a vein!" These are probably veins. This is probably a skin. This is probably a kamus. He reached his wife. He dropped everything at the door at once. His wife went out. "Look, go away!" - she laughs, she laughed, and he too: "Ha ha ha!". The terrible witcher burst into the laughter. He laughs, so you can hear it even throughout the forest. Just as his wife laughed at him, he laughed too. His wife was glad about him. After all, he brought so many things. Now the woman has to do all this. She has to scrape, she has to sew. She doesn't have any needle, what will she have? ... she made, maybe while you're walking around the tents you'll find something else? Ask for a needle and a scraper for me. Ask for a scraper, a needle, a thimble for me.". So, he probably thought: "She needs all this too.". He left. He left, he left, and while he is going around. He appeared again at another camp place. Then he thought. This witcher thought, probably he thought, probably he understands in his mind: "This is all for what - the skin needs to be skinned. Look, sewing is necessary, that's probably what it's like.". The witcher understood it. All the people from these many tents came out into the street while he was walking, while the witcher was walking. All the women threw things under the nose of the terrible one. His song can be heard from a distant land. The forest trembles because of his song. "This is necessary, a needle is necessary, a scraper is necessary, a thimble is necessary.". Another woman appears and throws thimbles under his nose. One more woman took out a needle and a scraper. He took this all with his palm. He turned again to the sun silently. At their eyes, he seemed to take only two steps. Say, so he left quickly. As for such steps, only two steps, and he's already gone. He reached his tent, and his tent was in a terrible impenetrable forest. He reached his tent and took such a song. "I brought you scrapers," he said to his wife. "These are probably scrapers". He says this so that his wife can hear him. "This is probably a needle". "This is probably a thimble". At some point his wife came to the door: how does the giant there? His footprints are terrible. And his sound is so that the snow crackles in a distant place. He is heard to have come. His wife went out again. His wife laughed to him. He also burst into loud laughter: "Ha-ha-ha!". While his wife was laughing to him, he laughed too. Well, and then she probably thought, "Now he is a human, a man like a human, I will be the wife of a true man.". The terrible one wanted a child. Well, while living together so long, of course there will be one. They got a child. So what, he is half a true human, his half. Of course, say. His body is, of course, hairy. His father has a hairy body, his body is hairy. And everything about him is like that of a true human. His mother is a true human, after all. This woman raises her child according to her custom. She gave him some clothing. Even if he has hair on his body. Of course, then he started walking together with his father. Then he grew up, and when he grew up, he began to walk together with his father. This woman began to dress her child in human clothes. She probably did something for him. When they came to people, people thought, say, "His child looks completely like a human. But what about him, he's terrible, after all. He is completely hairy. His father is the hairy body, hairy body. People think, say, "His child looks completely like a human". Who knows, who knows that the woman was carried away by a hairy body? How can they know? This child, people say, looks like a human being. How does he know human affairs? (...). When he was little, the mother sometimes, of course, spoke to her child a human language. She would speak a human language, she taught her child a little in her language. When he later went around with his father, people spoke their own language, he appeared to look like a human. Well, he doesn't look a human, he doesn't look like a hairy body. He is so, he wants to talk to people. He opens (his mouth) a bit, say. Then people thought: "He is half human, he seems to be human, where did he find such one? He himself is terrible. Completely hairy." Well. To the people ... Having stayed with the people, they left. So they show themselves to people and then leave again. Then the woman said at some point. He somehow understood her ... The woman said. I don't know what he feeds his wife with. And then, after that, this hairy body one day got to domestic deer. So he sees that a human woman probably wants human food. Of course she wants. She's used to reindeer. Probably she wants. Without anything, without a lasso, without anything, he will catch a reindeer, in one step towards the reindeer, he will grab it by the horns, he will twist its neck, and throw it on its back. One time he came. Oh, ... the giant to the door, he went around without his child. His child is already older. Then his wife went outside. The terrible one brought a reindeer, a reindeer, on his back, on his shoulders. He threw it, he lit a huge fire, he lit a huge fire. He threw it whole into the fire, he threw it whole. The chimney is all covered with in intestines. Where could the hairy body see that people the remove intestines? He turned it over with the intestines on the other side, and according to him, it was cooked. So they started eating. The woman, of course, really wanted it, she wanted human food. So she eats with all his might. Then one day the witcher, having eaten, fell asleep like a dead. A lot of things came to the woman's mind. How can she do? "What if I don't leave, what if I leave?". Having eaten so much raw meat, the witcher fell on his back, say. The woman thinks and thinks. "Where will I go? Wherever I go, he will surely find me.". She thinks: and now, she has a child, he is anyway half a witcher. So she thinks: "Look, how many years have already passed.". Now her husband has stopped looking for her and has even taken the children somewhere far away. "Where will I go?" The woman thinks: "I'll calm down here.". This is how they live now. Humans, they gave birth to half human children. And then some of their children understand human language. They would come to people and talk to them some times in the human language, say. As for them, they do in some way, probably. They think, people say: "There are a lot of them, why is this happening here, they look like people in appearance.". Now, people now say that people descended from witchers. We are probably half of these children.
